data.name: Mustaqim
data.gender_notes: Mustaqim is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Mustaqim is derived from the Arabic word mustaqim, which means 'just', 'fair', 'upright', or 'straight'. It is a name that is associated with being righteous and walking on the straight path of guidance. In the Quran, Allah Almighty says, 'And We have already sent Messengers as bringers of good news and as warners before this, so that mankind may have no argument against Allah after the coming of the Messengers. And Allah is Almighty, Wise.', (Al-Qasas 28:48). The name Mustaqim reflects the guidance and justice of Allah and is a reminder to always strive for righteousness and fairness in all aspects of life.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder to stay on the path of guidance and righteousness.
data.etymology: Mustaqim belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Walks on the Straight Path.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mustaqim total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
